When we're under pressure, our bodies release stress hormones like adrenaline, which can increase our heart rate, make us feel more alert, and even cause a sensation of warmth or tingling.

This is often referred to as the 'fight or flight' response. In the context of writing, it can lead to a heightened focus, but it can also cause us to make more errors due to increased anxiety.
